ucs.title: [LLM] Conti/Wizard Spider: BazarLoader/Cobalt Strike beacon spawned from Office macro, followed by AdFind + nltest recon
ucs.description: Hunts Conti's signature intrusion chain where a malicious Office document spawns a loader (BazarLoader/IcedID/TrickBot) which then injects into a Cobalt Strike beacon and immediately runs AD reconnaissance via adfind.exe and nltest /dclist — a tradecraft pairing documented in the leaked Conti playbooks.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="adfind.exe" OR Processes.process_name="nltest.exe" OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*group*Domain Admins*","*group*Enterprise Admins*","*group /domain*")) OR (Processes.process_name="net1.exe" AND Processes.process="*group*domain*")) by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name _time span=1h | rename Processes.* as * | eventstats dc(process_name) as distinct_recon_tools by host user | where distinct_recon_tools>=2 OR (process_name="adfind.exe" AND match(cmdline,"(?i)-f|trustdmp|subnets|gpolist")) | sort 0 -firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ReconWindow = 1h;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let LoaderHints = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
        or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "regsvr32.exe" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("/i:","/s","scrobj.dll"))
    | where FileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe")
        or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DownloadString","IEX","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String")
    | project LoaderTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, LoaderParent = InitiatingProcessFileName, LoaderCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let ContiRecon = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "adfind.exe")
        or (FileName =~ "nltest.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/dclist","/domain_trusts","/dsgetdc"))
        or (FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("group \"domain admins\"","group \"enterprise admins\"","group /domain","localgroup administrators"))
        or (FileName =~ "whoami.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/groups")
        or (FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "view" and ProcessCommandLine has "/domain")
    | project ReconTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ReconTool = FileName, ReconCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ReconParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
ContiRecon
| join kind=inner LoaderHints on DeviceId
| where ReconTime between (LoaderTime .. LoaderTime + ReconWindow)
| summarize ReconToolsUsed = make_set(ReconTool), SampleReconCmds = make_set(ReconCmd, 10),
            LoaderCmds = make_set(LoaderCmd, 5), FirstLoader = min(LoaderTime), LastRecon = max(ReconTime)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
| where array_length(ReconToolsUsed) >= 2 or set_has_element(ReconToolsUsed, "adfind.exe")
| order by LastRecon desc

        or (NewName =~ "whoami.exe" and CommandLine has "/groups")
    | project ReconTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, ReconTool = NewName, ReconCmd = CommandLine;
ContiRecon
| join kind=inner LoaderHints on Computer

ucs.title: [LLM] Conti pre-encryption sabotage: vssadmin/wbadmin/wmic shadow-copy wipe + bcdedit recovery disable + service stoppage chain
ucs.description: Catches Conti's hard-coded pre-encryption routine (lifted directly from the leaked Conti ransomware source code) that deletes volume shadow copies via multiple binaries, disables Windows Recovery Environment via bcdedit, and stops backup/AV/SQL services via net stop or taskkill — executed on every host minutes before the .CONTI extension write.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as binaries values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*stop*sql*","*stop*veeam*","*stop*backup*","*stop*memtas*","*stop*mepocs*","*stop*sophos*")) OR (Processes.process_name="taskkill.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*sqlserver*","*veeam*","*backup*","*sophos*"))) by host Processes.user _time span=10m | stats values(binaries) as binaries values(cmdlines) as cmdlines dc(binaries) as distinct_binaries min(firstTime) as firstSighting max(lastTime) as lastSighting by host user | where distinct_binaries >= 3 | sort 0 -lastSighting
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ChainWindow = 10m;
let SabotageEvents = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | extend Sabotage = case(
        FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows", "vssadmin_delete",
        FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete", "wmic_shadowcopy",
        FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","systemstatebackup","backup"), "wbadmin_delete",
        FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"), "bcdedit_recovery",
        FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sql","veeam","backup","memtas","mepocs","sophos","vss","acronis"), "net_stop_backup",
        FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sqlservr","veeam","backup","sophos","acronis"), "taskkill_backup",
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Sabotage)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, Sabotage, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
SabotageEvents
| summarize SabotageTypes = make_set(Sabotage), SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 15),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            FirstSighting = min(Timestamp), LastSighting = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, ChainWindow)
| where array_length(SabotageTypes) >= 3   // 3+ distinct sabotage steps in 10m = Conti routine
| order by LastSighting desc

        NewName == "wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has_any ("catalog","systemstatebackup","backup"), "wbadmin_delete",
        NewName == "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"), "bcdedit_recovery",
        NewName == "net.exe" and CommandLine has "stop" and CommandLine has_any ("sql","veeam","backup","memtas","mepocs","sophos","vss","acronis"), "net_stop_backup",
        NewName == "taskkill.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("sqlservr","veeam","backup","sophos","acronis"), "taskkill_backup",
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Sabotage)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, Sabotage, NewName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName;

            FirstSighting = min(TimeGenerated), LastSighting = max(TimeGenerated)

ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@CommandLine:(*\"delete shadows\"* OR *\"shadowcopy delete\"* OR *\"delete catalog\"* OR *\"recoveryenabled no\"* OR *\"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures\"*) OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\Net.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*stop* AND (*sql* OR *veeam* OR *memtas* OR *mepocs* OR *sophos* OR *backup* OR *acronis*))) OR (@Image:(*\\taskkill.exe OR *\\TASKKILL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*sqlservr* OR *veeam* OR *sophos* OR *acronis*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *bootstatuspolicy*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup|backup)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\net1?\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/stop\s+.*(sql|veeam|memtas|mepocs|sophos|backup|acronis|vss)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\taskkill\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(sqlservr|veeam|sophos|acronis|backup)/i)
| sabotage_type := if(ImageFileName=/vssadmin/i, "vssadmin", if(ImageFileName=/wmic/i, "wmic", if(ImageFileName=/wbadmin/i, "wbadmin", if(ImageFileName=/bcdedit/i, "bcdedit", if(ImageFileName=/net1?\.exe/i, "net_stop", "taskkill")))))
| bucket(span=10m, function=collect([sabotage_type, CommandLine, ImageFileName]))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(field=sabotage_type, distinct=true, as=DistinctSabotage), collect([CommandLine])])
| DistinctSabotage >= 3
ucs.rationale: The leaked Conti ransomware source code (Feb-2022 'ContiLeaks' dump by the Ukrainian-aligned insider) contains the exact pre-encryption chain hard-coded in the binary: vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet, wmic shadowcopy delete, wbadmin delete catalog, bcdedit recoveryenabled No + bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures, then a kill-list of ~180 service/process names targeting SQL, Veeam, Acronis, Soph
